_note: Versions locked in Gemfile.lock as of 2026-10-25 on the Phase 16 branch (upgrade/phase-16-rails-8-1, stacked on Phase 15 #238 and Phase 13 #235; main is at Phase 12, Rails 7.2.4). Latest published versions live in latest_versions.json (regenerate with fetch_latest_versions.py); newest release per minor line via gem_lines.py.

nokogiri.source: Gemfile.lock, Dockerfiles gem install nokogiri -v 1.19.4; Phase 13
nokogiri.notes: Latest; requires Ruby >= 3.2. The Dockerfile pin matches the lockfile, so the image reuses the precompiled aarch64-linux-gnu / x86_64-linux-gnu gem (libxml 2.13.9 packaged) instead of compiling libxml2 — the pre-install is only useful while the two agree (PR #229 finding).

pg.notes: Latest. Precompiled aarch64-linux / x86_64-linux gems with bundled libpq 18.6 and OpenSSL; declares Ruby >= 3.1, < 4.1, so it is the version carried through Phase 18. The image's libpq-dev is only a source-build fallback now.

puma.notes: Latest. config/puma.rb pins the bind host to 0.0.0.0 because puma 8 defaults to :: when any non-loopback IPv6 address exists; persistent_timeout is now 65 s (above the ALB's 60 s idle timeout, the recommended ordering).

devise.notes: Latest. config.secret_key is set explicitly from ENV['SECRET_KEY_BASE'] (config/initializers/devise.rb:11). Its recoverable tokens derive from ActiveSupport::KeyGenerator, which Phase 11's load_defaults 7.0 moves from SHA1 to SHA256.

jwt.notes: Latest. Strict Base64 decoding; spec/services/jwt_token_service_spec.rb covers the round trip and the error classes. JwtTokenService still reads Rails.application.secrets.secret_key_base — Phase 11 moves it to Rails.application.secret_key_base (same value in production).

bootstrap.notes: 5.3.8 is a design-breaking migration; standing note in upgrade_path.json. Its SCSS produces 307 Dart Sass deprecation warnings, hidden by config.sass.quiet_deps since Phase 9.

omniauth_rails_csrf_protection.notes: latest; drops ActiveSupport::Configurable, which Rails 8.1 deprecates and 8.2 removes — no Configurable reference in app/, config/, lib/ or spec/, and no such deprecation emitted by the suite under 8.1.4 (Phase 16)

active_model_serializers.notes: latest; low-maintenance gem; declares support through Rails 8. Verified under Rails 8.1.4 (Phase 16): rspec spec/requests green against spec/support/api_schemas/*.json

haml.notes: Latest (gem_lines.py 2026-10-25: 7.5.1 is the newest 7.x, Ruby >= 3.2). Was 5.2.2 (2021-05-29) until Phase 17. 6.0 replaced the implementation with Hamlit and removed every helper except preserve — surround/succeed in automation_scenarios/show.html.haml were rewritten as `= "...#{}..."` interpolation with byte-identical output; 7.0 switched the default attribute quote from ' to " (accepted, no attr_quote override). Rendered HTML of 21 pages/mailers was identical to haml 5.2.2 apart from the quote change. Runtime deps prism (>= 1.1.0), temple (>= 0.8.2), thor, tilt — all already in the lock (temple 0.10.4, tilt 2.0.8 unchanged).

haml_rails.notes: Latest. Was 2.1.0 until Phase 17. Runtime deps actionpack / activesupport / railties >= 5.1 and haml >= 4.0.6, so it admits Rails 7.2 today and Rails 8.x later; only its generators and the Haml::RailsTemplate handler registration (via haml itself) matter to this app.

dartsass_sprockets.notes: Latest. Replaced sass-rails 6.0.0 / sassc-rails 2.1.2 / sassc 2.4.0 (libsass). See sass_embedded for the Dart Sass binary.

sass_embedded.notes: Latest; requires Ruby >= 3.2. Installs as the aarch64-linux-gnu / x86_64-linux-gnu binary gem (google-protobuf ~> 4.31) instead of the generic gem that downloaded Dart Sass at bundle install (1.102.0 was the last release admitting Ruby 3.1). The five application.scss @import deprecations still print on a cold sprockets cache; Bootstrap 5 territory.

terser.notes: Latest. Replaced uglifier 4.1.11; production.rb sets config.assets.js_compressor = :terser.

sprockets.notes: latest 4.x; Propshaft is for new apps only and would need the CoffeeScript migration first (standing note)

rspec_rails.notes: Latest; requires actionpack/activesupport/railties >= 7.2 (so railties 8.1.4 is admitted) and allows rspec-* < 5.0 (3.13.x locked). No spec change was needed on the 7.1.1 → 8.0.4 move nor on Rails 8.1; config.fixture_paths has been in spec/rails_helper.rb since Phase 11.

rubocop.source: Gemfile.lock (rubocop ~> 1.92, rubocop-rails 2.38.0, rubocop-rspec 3.10.2, rubocop-capybara 3.1.0, rubocop-factory_bot 2.28.0); Phase 10, PR #227
rubocop.notes: Latest. .rubocop.yml uses `plugins:`; TargetRubyVersion 4.0 since Phase 18 (3.4 in Phases 13–17) with NewCops disable. 1.9x accepts TargetRubyVersion 3.4 and 4.0 (1.28 rejected anything above 3.2). The 4.0 target produced two Lint/RedundantRequireStatement offences — `require 'pathname'` in bin/setup and bin/update, since Pathname is core in Ruby 4.0 — fixed by removing the lines; nothing else changed.

selenium_webdriver.notes: latest; requires Ruby >= 3.3. Dropped its rexml dependency (rexml 3.4.4 left the lock) and widened rubyzip to < 4.0 (2.4.1 kept). No spec is tagged js: true and no driver is registered, so effectively unused

simplecov.notes: latest; requires Ruby >= 3.3. 1.x has no docile / simplecov-html / simplecov_json_formatter dependencies (all three left the lock); `SimpleCov.start 'rails'` in spec/spec_helper.rb still writes coverage/index.html

shoulda_matchers.notes: latest; requires Ruby >= 3.3 and activesupport >= 7.2. The suite uses validate_numericality_of, validate_presence_of, belong_to, route and redirect_to; all pass unchanged. The chilled-string warnings seen in the Ruby 4.0 spike came from 5.3.0 and are gone.

annotaterb.source: Gemfile.lock; Phase 10, PR #227 (replaced annotate 3.2.0, which does not load on Rails 7.2+)
annotaterb.notes: latest; .annotaterb.yml reproduces the existing annotations byte for byte (classified_sort false)

pry.source: Gemfile.lock; spec/spec_helper.rb requires it first; Phase 10, PR #227
pry.notes: latest. 0.12.2 failed to load on Ruby >= 3.2 (Object#=~ removed) and took the whole suite with it — PR #229 finding, now cleared

byebug.notes: latest; requires Ruby >= 3.2 and depends on reline >= 0.6.0 (0.7.0 locked). Compiles on ruby:3.4.12-slim-bookworm, on Trixie (Phase 14) and on ruby:4.0.9-slim-trixie (Phase 18, 6 GCC warnings, 0 errors). 10.0.2 did not compile under Trixie's GCC 14 — PR #229 finding, cleared by Phase 10. Gemfile line is `platforms: %w[mri windows]` since Phase 18 (Bundler 4 deprecates :mingw / :x64_mingw). Ruby 4.0.9 bundles reline 0.6.3 next to the locked 0.7.0, hence the `ambiguous specs: reline` WARN once per rspec boot

web_console.notes: Latest; requires railties and actionview >= 8.0.0 (why Phase 13 held it back) and no longer depends on activemodel. development.rb's config.web_console.whiny_requests = false is still a 4.3.0 setting.

minitest.source: Gemfile.lock (transitive of activesupport / rspec-rails); moved deliberately in Phase 13
minitest.notes: Requires Ruby >= 3.1 with no upper cap. The standing note's `>= 5.26` check for Phase 18 is closed: 5.17.0 declared Ruby < 4.0, which broke the frozen install in the Ruby 4.0 spike; neither Phase 11 nor 12 moved it under --conservative, so Phase 13 named it in the update set. Confirmed in Phase 18: on ruby:4.0.9 (bundled minitest 6.0.0) the lock kept 5.27.0 through `bundle lock`, the image build and `BUNDLE_FROZEN=true bundle install` with no re-resolution.
